d: Diwali or Deepavali? While the festival of lights is celebrated across India, the traditions, rituals and food associated with it differ across regions. In Tamil Nadu and much of South India, the festival is known as Deepavali and follows a distinct set of customs. From the rituals performed early in the morning to traditional festive foods, Tamil Deepavali has several differences from the way Diwali is celebrated in North India. Writer Sabita Radhakrishna explains what makes Tamil Deepavali unique, how its traditions evolved and why the celebrations differ between North and South India.
